name: endnotex9
description: The endnotex9 plugin: a local-first MCP server plus reference-management skills for EndNote X9.

plugins.name: endnotex9
plugins.description: One MCP server over an EndNote X9 library (search, full text, citations, backup-first field writeback) and four skills: lit-cleaner, lit-downloader, lit-classifier, lit-deep-reader. Requires uv; the library never leaves the machine.
